description: Stable observation-unit identifier generated by downstream pipeline.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: No raw IDs or PII; hash observer identifiers before export.

description: Canonical stream code used for interpretation and protocol checks.
validation: Must be one of ebird, birdata, ala, eaws.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Stream-level terms from permission protocol apply.

description: Hydrology support identifier from Goal 020 table.
validation: Must match a known support_id in goal-020 readiness.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Do not infer support_id from coarse private points.

description: Observation month in YYYY-MM.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Use hydrology month boundaries even when raw timestamp is finer.

description: Provider-level stable record ID or event ID.
validation: Must not be empty and should be stable after dedupe.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Keep identifiers in hashed or pseudonymised form when possible.

description: Species or taxon identifier used for joins (eBird/ALA taxon keys or equivalent).
validation: Must be present and normalised to project taxon dictionary.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Preserve sensitive-species handling flags if provided.

description: Accepted taxon label for reporting and joins.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Check synonyms against source vocabulary before modelling.

description: Provisional guild tag from screen table.
validation: Should use controlled provisional guild vocabulary.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Can be redrafted in later goals.

description: Observed count for count-capable records.
validation: Allow null/0 for checklist non-detection rows.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Interpret as count proxy only; include effort offset.

description: Observed vs. non-observed state at the unit level.
validation: Must be true for presence records, false for validated non-detection lanes.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: False values only from complete-checklist or fully audited routes.

description: Relative-count metric family selected by lane.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Must match lane contract in join table.

description: Event date for high-resolution audits.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Store month only if full timestamp is disallowed.

description: Observer effort duration.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Sensitive only if includes private field details; keep as aggregate.

description: Observation effort distance.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: May be null for static-point or fixed-area counts.

description: Estimated observation area.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Use broad bins when precise area cannot be shared.

description: Hashed observer token for QA and repeatability.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Do not store raw observer names/emails.

description: Protocol label used for effort interpretation.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Stream protocol restrictions apply.

description: Point precision or grid-cell resolution proxy.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Use published sensitive suppression precision where required.

description: Sensitive/species or location suppression indicator.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Route suppressed rows to support-level summary only.

description: Sensitivity disclosure level.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Respect stream-specific non-disclosure rules.

description: Observed breeding or reproductive evidence indicator.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Use only for validation or breeding-specific analyses.

description: Licence or permission context retained for provenance.
validation: Store source terms version if available.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Do not override source terms in downstream exports.

description: Canonical source URL or API endpoint for audit.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: No raw payload URLs for restricted private exports.

description: Human-readable provenance and preprocessing note.
validation: Describe filtering, dedupe, and harmonisation decisions.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Used for lab-review and audit.

description: Whether row is eligible for Goal 021 pilot tables.
validation: Boolean derived from stream role and hydrology eligibility.
privacy_sensitivity_notes: Set false for records currently parked for later goal.
